name: quota-sentry
description: Codex quota guard that classifies short-term and weekly usage windows and waits near reset.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor Codex quota and wait before a configured window is exhausted.
interface.longDescription: Quota Sentry is a local Codex helper that uses Codex app-server rate-limit data to classify canonical quota windows by duration, runs a background poller every five minutes by default, guards short-term usage, hard-blocks weekly usage at 99% by default, and provides a synchronous guard command for Codex hooks or wrappers to wait until reset.
defaultPrompt: Set up Quota Sentry for Codex.
Check my Codex quota guard status.
